comments.body:
Thanks, Alex — this fixes the SSE format mismatch, and preserving whitespace and a stable response ID is helpful. I reviewed `75cf123`, ran 46 related tests successfully, and verified that the local OpenAI SDK can parse the response and reconstruct the original text.

Could you address one OpenAPI regression before we merge? Changing the route to `response_model=None` removes the existing `ChatCompletionResponse` schema: the documented 200 response becomes `application/json: {schema: {}}`, and `text/event-stream` is not declared either. Clients generated from OpenAPI lose the response structure, including `choices` and `usage`.

Please keep `response_model=ChatCompletionResponse` and add `text/event-stream` as another 200 response media type through `responses`. FastAPI passes a returned `StreamingResponse` through directly, so keeping the JSON response model does not force SSE into JSON. I tested that combination locally and the SSE response still worked. The [FastAPI documentation](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/additional-responses/#additional-media-types-for-the-main-response) shows how to declare multiple response media types.

An OpenAPI regression test checking that both the JSON model reference and SSE media type are present would cover this alongside the existing response tests.

One documentation note: this implementation waits for the full answer before emitting SSE chunks. Keeping this PR focused on SSE compatibility makes sense; please make that buffering behavior explicit and update the compatibility note in `skills/landppt-ppt-generation/references/endpoints.md`, which still says `stream:true` returns JSON.

The build and validation checks are green. No live paid API requests were made during my review. Thanks for taking a look!

Kept `response_model=ChatCompletionResponse` and declared `text/event-stream` through `responses`. The new OpenAPI test checks the JSON model reference and SSE media type; all three response tests pass. The endpoint documentation and compatibility reference now explicitly describe buffering the full answer before emitting SSE chunks. No live paid API requests were made.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
